question: Why is LuKARS described as a semi-distributed model? (Select ONE correct answer.)
success: Correct. LuKARS represents spatial variability through hydrotopes while retaining a conceptual lower model structure.
error: Not quite. Focus on how the recharge area is subdivided.

question: Which statements correctly describe hydrotopes? (Select ALL correct answers.)
success: Correct. Hydrotopes are distinct response units that provide a semi-distributed representation of the recharge area.
error: Not quite. Consider why the model uses several hydrotopes rather than one uniform recharge unit.

question: Which flux transfers water slowly from a hydrotope toward the matrix? (Select ONE correct answer.)
success: Correct. Qis represents slow infiltration from a hydrotope toward the matrix.
error: Not quite. Distinguish the slow hydrotope pathway from rapid flow and lower-compartment fluxes.

question: What is the role of Emin and Emax? (Select ONE correct answer.)
success: Correct. The two thresholds form the hysteresis mechanism controlling rapid hydrotope flow.
error: Not quite. Think about when fast hydrotope flow becomes active and inactive.

question: Why are two different thresholds used for fast-flow activation and deactivation? (Select ONE correct answer.)
success: Correct. Separate thresholds allow activation and deactivation to occur at different storage levels.
error: Not quite. Consider the meaning of hysteresis.

question: Which statements describe matrix-conduit exchange? (Select ALL correct answers.)
success: Correct. Matrix-conduit exchange can be bidirectional and depends on the storage difference and exchange parameters.
error: Not quite. Consider both the direction and the controlling parameters.

question: Which parameter most directly controls conduit drainage toward the spring? (Select ONE correct answer.)
success: Correct. kCS controls the conduit-to-spring drainage relationship.
error: Not quite. Identify the parameter associated with QCS.

question: Why should internal storages and fluxes be inspected in addition to spring discharge? (Select ONE correct answer.)
success: Correct. Similar outlet behaviour can arise from different parameter combinations and internal process representations.
error: Not quite. Think about equifinality and process realism.
